final_run_1 N=512 'ufsecp C ABI batch' and final_run_2 N=2 batch rows had a disturbed pass (max >> min); their medians are within 1% of the other run except final_run_1 N=512 C ABI (median disturbed, 40.8 us vs 24.97 us on rerun)

with_lanes_avx2: same host setup, adds the 'ufsecp lanes avx2' row (bch_schnorr_verify_lanes, 4 lanes); AVX2 has no 52-bit multiply, so the lane row is slower than scalar verify on this CPU; the AVX-512 IFMA backends cannot run here
